summary.text: Shane Lindauer, a Republican from Jasper, represents Indiana House District 63, which includes all of Martin County and portions of Daviess, Dubois and Pike counties.
He chairs the Natural Resources Committee, and the House honored him in February 2026 as a retiring member.

paragraphs.text: According to his caucus biography, Lindauer earned a Bachelor of Science in industrial supervision technology from Indiana State University and a Doctorate of Chiropractic and a Bachelor of Science in health and human sciences from Logan College of Chiropractic.
He served on the Dubois County Council from 2010 to 2014 and has been an adjunct professor at Oakland City University and Ivy Tech.
In the House he also serves on the Roads and Transportation Committee.
The page lists his community involvement as including Redemption Christian Church and serving as a Cub Scouts den leader.
